newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Jordanian for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Jordanian for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Jordanian man for smuggling heroin and hashish into the kingdom, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.

A ministry statement carried on Saudi state television said Mohammad bin Faleh Salman al-Huwaiti was executed in the northwestern city of Tabuk, about 100 km (60 miles) from the border to Jordan, after being found guilty of taking unspecified amounts of the drugs into Saudi Arabia.
The beheading raised to 20 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
